observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT  
Safety: CAUTION  
Issues: The image is a lateral chest radiograph (L marker), which is not adequate to reliably grade scoliosis; extensive posterior spinal fusion hardware spans multiple thoracic levels, so “mild scoliosis” may reflect residual postoperative curvature rather than the original deformity severity; the claim that hardware alone proves severe scoliosis is not independently supported by this image.  
Suggestion: Confirm scoliosis severity with a frontal/PA view or the radiology report rather than inferring severity from the lateral view or fusion hardware alone.
